clues.text: On the mountain, Isaac's father found one caught by its horns in a thicket and offered it instead of his son.
In Daniel's vision by the Ulai Canal, this two-horned animal stood for the kings of Media and Persia.
Seven priests carried horns from this animal in front of the ark while marching around Jericho.
Moses was told to cover the tabernacle tent with its skins, dyed red.
Under the law given to Moses, someone who sinned in ignorance brought an unblemished one from the flock as a guilt offering.
When Aaron was ordained, Moses put its blood on his right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe.
Balaam told Balak, king of Moab, to build seven altars and prepare seven bulls and seven of these animals.
